title: It's ok.
text: It's ok.. It puts together easily. I did it while watching a movie. But once done, it was a little wobbly (one leg doesn't quite touch the ground). I'm keeping it because I'm using it as an end table between a wall and the couch so the wobbliness doesn't really matter.

product_metadata.title: Slim Entry Table - Space-Saving Accent Table with Distressed Finish - Black
features: Add a stylish home decor accent with functionality when you place this hallway accent table in your home. A distressed finish on the stylish wood makes this a table you'll want to keep up forever.
Made from sturdy engineered wood, this entryway table is sturdy and features two sawtooth hangers on the back of it to brace it against the walls to help keep it sturdy and in one spot.
Not only does this slim end accent table look fantastic in the entryway, but you can use it all through the home if you so desire. Place it in the hallways for a surface to place car keys or wallets.

Keep this stylish accent end table for your home or give it as a housewarming to the young couple who bought their first home. Apartment dwellers and college students would also make use of this table.
MDF. Assembly required; assembly hardware included. 36"W x 7"D x 32"H
